mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly industrial production (INDPRO) show positive momentum relative to their 3-month moving averages, it indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and INDPRO are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, high consumer spending (RSAFS) above the 90th percentile signals economic overheating, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS is above 90th percentile during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) level above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceed 150,000, it signals a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL mo-mo change > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,200,000 units, it signals robust consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
